food_rule: Except during stuck recovery, target the nearest visible uncollected pellet that is not temporarily cooled down. Food takes priority over normal exploration.
exploration_rule: If no pellet is visible, target the nearest unvisited grid-cell centre.
persistence_rule: Keep an exploration target until its centre is reached or visible food interrupts it.
fallback_rule: If every cell has been visited, target the least recently occupied cell.
movement_rule: Neural outputs choose heading within 60 degrees of the target direction and throttle from 0.2 to 1.0. Direct reference heads straight to the same target at full speed.
scope: Empty or complex arena. No access to unseen food. No predator, hunger, exploration reward, or pathfinding. Target selection and heading constraints are programmed. On terrain, the 60-degree cone may prevent necessary detours.
terrain_goal_rule: Use the nearest clear representative point to each tile centre within the largest body-accessible region; ignore tiles with no accessible sites.
recovery_rule: After 2 seconds confined within 1 map cell, set aside the current food/tile target for 20 seconds. Temporarily override food priority; choose a locally collision-clear escape waypoint and steer directly to it at 60% speed for up to 3 seconds, then resume normal rules. Retry only after another 2-second observation window. Recovery is programmed, not evolved.
